scripts.test: node --test "src/**/*.test.mjs" && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),cp=require('node:child_process');const files=[];function walk(dir){for(const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true}).sort((a,b)=>a.name.localeCompare(b.name))){const file=path.join(dir,entry.name);if(entry.isDirectory())walk(file);else if(entry.name.endsWith('.test.jsx'))files.push(file)}}walk('src');if(!files.length)throw new Error('No .test.jsx files found');const result=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,[require.resolve('vitest/vitest.mjs'),'run',...files],{stdio:'inherit'});process.exit(result.status??1)"
